description: Combined PRD evidence from two isolated Codex/Ralph stream worktrees. Verification and PR gate run on this integration branch.

userStories.title: Repair RLS Performance Gate Flake
userStories.story: As a backend maintainer, I want the CEL row-level-security performance gate to remain meaningful without failing under normal package-suite CPU contention, so stream verification can reliably distinguish regressions from test-environment variance.

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Focused RLS performance gate remains enforced
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pkg/security CEL RLS evaluator test suite runs in standard, non-instrumented mode
acceptanceCriteria.then: the test logs the selected standard profile and passes with cache stats showing warm-cache hits

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Full package gate is not blocked by the RLS performance test
acceptanceCriteria.given: the repository runs the Go package list used by CI
acceptanceCriteria.then: the command exits successfully or exposes a different unrelated failure, and `pkg/security` no longer fails `TestRLSEvaluator_PerformanceGate` due only to wall-clock variance

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Instrumented CI profile stays tolerant of race and coverage overhead
acceptanceCriteria.given: race or coverage instrumentation is active
acceptanceCriteria.when: the RLS perf profile helper is evaluated
acceptanceCriteria.then: it keeps the lower-iteration, wider-budget instrumented profile

evidenceRequired: Targeted red/green output for the adjusted RLS performance profile
Relevant Go package gate evidence after the repair

userStories.title: Admin Performance Route Alias
userStories.story: As an operator using browser dogfood navigation, I want the label-derived /admin/performance URL to resolve to the Performance Dashboard so direct typing and bookmarks do not fall through to the Not Found page.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an authenticated admin starts at /admin/performance, when the SPA router evaluates the route, then it redirects to /admin/perf and renders the Performance Dashboard heading.
Given an authenticated admin starts at /admin/performance, when the page renders, then the Not Found page is not mounted.
Given the existing dogfood alias suite runs, when route aliases are checked, then /admin/performance is covered alongside the other label-derived aliases.
